# gitea_user_actions_variable (Resource)

`gitea_user_actions_variable` manages a user-scoped Actions variable.

Import expects the resource ID in the form `variable_name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitea_user_actions_variable" "example" {
  variable_name = "GLOBAL_ENV"
  value         = "production"
  description   = "User-scoped Actions variable"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `value` (String) The user-scoped Actions variable value.
- `variable_name` (String) The user-scoped Actions variable name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The user-scoped Actions variable description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Using `import` blocks in Terraform v1.5.0 and later:

```terraform
import {
  to = gitea_user_actions_variable.example
  id = "<variable_name>"
}
```

Using `terraform import` in Terraform v1.4.0 and earlier:

```shell
terraform import gitea_user_actions_variable.example <variable_name>
```
